notes.title: About the update
notes.content:
I apologize for the lack of recent updates
At the end of October, I have a big test called a real estate agent
I'm so focused on studying that I don't have much time to invest in update
I promise you that there will be frequent updates when it is over,
regardless of whether you pass the exam or not.
Currently, I've implemented low noise, recoil barrel like VSS and multi-barrel like mini-guns.
Besides that, I'm going to add various parts to the next update.

notes.title: Graphic update
notes.content:
The long and long work is over.
Now Ponchoman resolution has been double. 
You can feel a much more detailed description.
This is not the end of the update.
There will be some adjustments in the future and I promise there will be additional content.

The store page image will be modified shortly.

notes.title: Graphic update status report - 1
notes.content:
The resolution has doubled, so it became more detailed
The Creature is no longer a moving pixel fragments.
This was the first image I had in mind, and I'm satisfied that it came out better than I thought.
The update is still a long way off but I'll get it done as soon as possible.

notes.title: Graphic update in progress
notes.content:
As you know, ponchoman is a low-resolution pixel game.
It's minimalistic. But I feel limited in expression.
So I'm trying to double the resolution.

This work will take as little as a few days
The update will take place within May at the latest.
